status: DRAFT (bench-v1, table T1-H2; DEV phase only, nothing frozen)
model: Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B (Wan-AI / Alibaba Tongyi Lab; VACE: all-in-one video creation and editing on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B), used in its first-clip video extension mode

vace_code_last_changed.note: VACE added in 18d53feb (2025-05-14), size fix c709fcf0 (2025-05-14), formatting 76e94276 (2025-05-16); the only later code commit 841fe523 (2025-12-02) changes wan/image2video.py (not on the VACE path); later commits change README.md only

code.source_digest_rule: sha256 over the sorted *.py / *.yml / *.yaml files of the checkout (path NUL sha256 newline), .git and __pycache__ excluded (the rule of the SkyReels, Vista and LTX adapters)
code.install: none: the adapter puts the checkout on sys.path (the wan package) with bytecode writing disabled

vace_reference.use: documentation only (not run): the first-clip extension semantics and the long-video procedure
points: FrameRefExpandAnnotator mode 'firstclip': out_frames = the given clip + expand_num frames of REF_COLOR 127.5; out_masks = 0 for the given frames (kept) + 255 for the expansion (generated); the clip length is free, expand_num 80 by default
UserGuide 2.2: 'For users who are demanding of long video generation, we recommend to generate 5s video clips one by one, while using firstclip video extension task to keep the temporal consistency'
UserGuide 3.1: src_video gray areas (values equal to 127) are the missing part; src_mask white = generated, black = retained
save_one_video writes the preprocessed src_video / src_mask with imageio libx264 quality 8 (lossy): a constant 127.5 frame is written as 127
vace_wan_inference.py defaults: 50 steps, shift 16, guidance 5.0, unipc, 81 frames, model vace-1.3B, size 480p (the same as the Wan2.1 generate.py defaults)

weights.license: apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt: the Apache License 2.0 text; the model card adds: no rights claimed over generated content, the user is accountable for lawful use)
weights.dit: VaceWanModel (config.json: dim 1536, 30 layers, 12 heads, ffn 8960, vace_layers 0, 2, ..., 28 (15 VACE blocks), vace_in_dim 96); 2,153,972,032 parameters (734,975,232 in the VACE blocks), the file stores 825 fp32 and 439 bf16 tensors; VaceWanModel.from_pretrained (diffusers) loads them into the fp32 model

Wan2.1_VAE.pth.role: Wan2.1 VAE (fp32; byte-identical to the SkyReels-V2-DF checkpoint's)

models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth.role: umT5-XXL text encoder (bf16): only for the prompt cache (research server)

weights.sha256_note: LFS files: the Hub LFS sha256 of the pinned revision; small files: sha256 of the download whose git blob sha1 matched the Hub tree (2026-11-05)

released_defaults.source: generate.py of the pinned commit (_validate_args and argparse) and wan/vace.py; the same values in VACE's vace_wan_inference.py
released_defaults.size: SUPPORTED_SIZES['vace-1.3B'] = 480*832, 832*480; the model card: 480P (~81 x 480 x 832), 720P not supported for 1.3B; 'the input supports any resolution, but to achieve optimal results, the video size should fall within a specific range'. prepare_source sets the processor's area to W x H of --size and the official VaceVideoProcessor keeps an input video's own size when it is smaller than that area (area_z = min(seq_len, max_area / 256, (h // 16) (w // 16)))
released_defaults.sample_shift: 16 for vace tasks (_validate_args: 'elif "flf2v" in args.task or "vace" in args.task: args.sample_shift = 16'); the diffusers port uses 3.0 (not the official code)
released_defaults.n_prompt: '' -> config.sample_neg_prompt (the fixed Chinese negative prompt of shared_config.py, sha256 in the adapter)
released_defaults.base_seed: random if not given; torch.Generator(device).manual_seed(seed) for the noise and the scheduler steps
released_defaults.offload_model: True on one GPU (moves the DiT to the CPU after sampling and back; no numeric effect)
released_defaults.dtypes: T5 bf16; DiT fp32 parameters under torch.cuda.amp.autocast(bfloat16); VAE fp32; flash-attention 2 in bf16
released_defaults.fps: 16 (config.sample_fps; cache_video writes the output at this rate)
released_defaults.output: cache_video: clamp(-1, 1), (x + 1) / 2, x 255, uint8 truncation, imageio libx264 quality 8 (lossy; the adapter writes the same uint8 frames losslessly)

bench.timeline_rule: 16 fps global frame j (0..128) = camera frame c0 + m(j), c0 the window's t0 camera frame (window.json tick k = 0), m(j) = round_half_even(5 (j - 32) / 4): the 20 Hz camera frame nearest to t0_cam + (j - 32) / 16 s; the ties (25 ms each way, every j - 32 = 2 mod 4) go to the even offset, i.e. to the bench's 10 Hz frame. Every frame is a real camera frame (33 of the 41 history camera frames; one in five is skipped), timing error <= 25 ms, no drift
bench.tick_rule: bench tick k (-20..60) = global 16 fps frame 32 + round(1.6 k) (no ties); that frame is exactly the bench tick camera frame c0 + 2k for every k (so the real reference's tick frames are the bench's tick frames); a generated frame at tick k sits at model time round(1.6 k) / 16 s: +25, -12.5, +12.5, -25, 0 ms from the tick over each 0.5 s, exact at every 0.5 s multiple (all outcome horizons)
bench.round_rule: round 1: 81 frames = the 33 history frames (mask 0, kept) + 48 new frames (mask 1) = global frames 0-80; round 2: 81 frames = round 1's output frames 48-80 (t0 + 1.0 .. t0 + 3.0 s, mask 0) + 48 new frames = global frames 48-128; the bench ticks k = 1..30 come from round 1 (global frames 34..80), k = 31..60 from round 2 (its frames 34..80)
bench.prefix_rule: vision.mp4 frames 0-20 (ticks -20..0) = the real 33-frame history through the Wan VAE alone (encode, decode, the official uint8 conversion), shared by every clip of a window and by its real reference; frames 21-80 = the generated frames (continuations) or the real clip through the same VAE window by window (reference)
bench.prompt: the Nano prompt 'long' of make_bench_nano_specs.py, verbatim (as SkyReels-V2-DF and MAGI-1)
bench.seed_rule: round 1: seed_of(window, k); round 2: seed_of(window, f'{k}|r2'), each through torch.Generator(device).manual_seed(seed) inside the official WanVace.generate (the noise and the UniPC step)
bench.prompt_cache_rule: the official T5EncoderModel call (bf16 umT5-XXL on the GPU) on the fixed prompt and on the config's negative prompt, once, on the research server; the tensors are stored in a safetensors file with their provenance and sha256-checked by every job

canvas.note: the bench evaluation canvas itself (identity mapping); accepted by the official processor at area 480*832 without any resize (it keeps an input smaller than the area); 576 tokens per latent frame (480P: 1,560)

480p.note: the official 480P size of the 1.3B model; the band (1550 x 872, aspect 1.7775) rendered directly to 832 x 480 (aspect 1.7333: the picture is squeezed 2.5 % horizontally), every output frame mapped back to the canvas with cv2.INTER_AREA

bench.default_size_note: 832 x 480 (the official 480P size of the 1.3B model) after the 2026-11-05 size probe: at 512 x 288 VACE replaced the scene within 0.5-2 s in 2 of 4 smoke continuations and morphed the background in a third; at 832 x 480 the first round (3 s) stayed coherent (protocol-wan21-vace13b-v1-draft.md section 7). 512 x 288 stays one switch away (package wan21-vace13b-512-inputs-v1, SIZE=512)
bench.prompt_cache: prompt-cache/vace-t5-long.safetensors (+ .json) of every input package; made by run_vace_bench.py --make-prompt-cache on the research server (the official T5 call on its GPU)
